correctness.rationale: Verified headline window theorem line-by-line. F+ definition is sound: listed 7 triples cover all 21 pairs exactly once (re-ran STS check), expansion adds 7 distinct private vertices, so 7 quads on 14 vertices, linear with pairwise intersections exactly 1 (re-ran VERIFY_OK). Upper bound: each edge of a linear 4-graph covers 6 pairs with disjoint pair-sets, so 6e<=C(n,2), e<=n(n-1)/12, limsup<=1/12 — correct and independent of F+. Conflict-pair lemma: summing C(n-2,2)^2/2 over C(n,2) 2-sets counts every conflicting pair at least once; bound C(n-2,2)<=(n^2/2)/2 arithmetic gives <=n^6/16 — correct; exact values n=7..12 confirmed by exhaustive replay. Alteration: G^(4)(n,p), p=alpha/n^2, EX=C(n,4)p, EY<=N_conf p^2<=alpha^2 n^2/16, EZ<=n^14 p^7=alpha^7 (injective placements overcount distinct copies, so deleting one edge per labelled copy still eliminates every distinct copy; X-Y-Z is a valid lower bound on repaired edges). Finite expansion C(n,4)>=(n^4-6n^3)/24 holds since 11n^2-6n>=0. Hence E[e(H)]>=n^2(alpha/24-alpha^2/16)-alpha n/4-alpha^7. Identity alpha/24-alpha^2/16=1/144-(alpha-1/3)^2/16 verified over Fraction; max 1/144 at alpha=1/3 gives n^2/144-n/12-1/2187. Liminf>=1/144 follows. All boundary cases hold (negative finite bound is vacuous but true; max argument preserves existence). Computation (STS, F+ cert, conflict exact counts, optimizer identity) is confirmatory only; main proof is analytic. Seeded n=60 demo depends on unproved find_Fplus completeness and is correctly segregated as illustration, not proof. Limitations honestly stated: gap factor 12, no exact limit, no stability/uniqueness, no container claim.

No timestamp or failed search used as priority proof.
